Description: Mario and Luigi travel through the Mushroom Kingdom, jumping across platforms, avoiding enemies and overcoming obstacles to rescue Princess Peach from Bowser.

Name: Resident Evil
Description: A survival horror game in which a team of agents investigates an isolated mansion and discovers biological experiments. Players explore, solve puzzles, manage resources and fight creatures.

Name: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater
Description: A skateboarding game focused on performing tricks, completing objectives and exploring skate parks. Players chain moves together to earn high scores and unlock new areas and skaters.

Name: Super Smash Bros. for Wii U and 3DS
Description: A crossover fighting game featuring Nintendo characters and fighters from other franchises. It combines fast combat, interactive stages, items and numerous modes for one or more players.

Name: Warzone 2100
Description: A real-time strategy game set in a post-apocalyptic future. Players develop technology, build units and bases, and command military forces while attempting to rebuild civilization.

Name: Spyro the Dragon
Description: A 3D platformer starring Spyro, a young dragon who explores different worlds, rescues dragons, collects gems and defeats enemies using fire and charges.

Name: Link's Crossbow Training
Description: A Wii shooting game starring Link. Players use the Wii Zapper to practice aiming across scenarios inspired by Twilight Princess and complete score-based challenges.

Name: Fallout 3
Description: An open-world RPG set in a post-apocalyptic Washington, D.C. Players explore the wasteland, complete quests, make choices and develop skills while searching for their father.

Name: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time/Explorers of Darkness
Description: A dungeon-crawling RPG in which the player becomes a Pokémon. Players form a team, explore changing dungeons and uncover a story involving time travel.

Name: Uncharted: Drake's Fortune
Description: An action-adventure game starring Nathan Drake, who searches for the treasure of El Dorado. It combines exploration, platforming, shooting and puzzles in archaeological adventure settings.

Name: LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga
Description: An action-adventure game recreating the first six Star Wars films with LEGO characters and environments. It combines platforming, combat, puzzles and humor.

Name: Diddy Kong Racing
Description: A racing game featuring Rare characters, land, water and air vehicles, and varied tracks. It includes single-player and multiplayer modes and an adventure structured around an explorable world.

Name: Monster Hunter Freedom 3
Description: An action RPG for PSP focused on hunting monsters and crafting equipment. Players prepare weapons, study creature behavior and complete increasingly difficult missions.

Name: Dr. Mario
Description: A puzzle game in which players use colored capsules to eliminate viruses by forming groups of four matching elements. The game ends when all viruses are cleared or the bottle fills up.

Name: God of War III
Description: An action game starring Kratos during his final confrontation with the gods of Olympus. It combines intense combat, exploration, puzzles and large environments inspired by Greek mythology.

Name: StarCraft II: Wings of Liberty
Description: A real-time strategy game set in the StarCraft universe. The campaign follows Jim Raynor and his Terran forces against the Zerg and Protoss, alongside a major multiplayer component.

Name: Assassin's Creed
Description: An action-adventure and stealth game set during the Crusades. Assassin Altaïr must eliminate targets while uncovering a conspiracy involving the Assassins and Templars.

Name: FIFA 15
Description: A football simulator featuring licensed squads and competitions. It improves player emotions, ball physics and match presentation for a more dynamic football experience.

Name: Crash Team Racing
Description: A kart racing game starring Crash Bandicoot characters. Tracks feature items, shortcuts and obstacles, with racing and battle modes for competitive play.

Name: FIFA 17
Description: A football simulator featuring licensed teams and players. It introduces The Journey story mode and improves animations, physics and match presentation.

Name: Batman: Arkham City
Description: An action-adventure game set in a massive urban prison where Batman faces villains including the Joker and Hugo Strange. It combines combat, stealth, exploration and puzzle solving.
